offering_description.value: Brookdale provides housing and care for older adults through assisted living, memory care, independent living, and continuing care retirement communities. It operates the communities and provides on-site services such as meals, help with daily activities, and skilled nursing at select locations.

primary_services.value: assisted living; memory care; independent living; continuing care retirement communities; skilled nursing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Older adults seeking senior housing or care, and families arranging care on their behalf

end_markets.value: senior housing; long-term care; dementia care; skilled nursing

revenue_model.value: service fees: Monthly resident charges for personal care, meals, and other community services; rental or leasing: Monthly accommodation charges for senior living apartments; healthcare reimbursement: Medicare or Medicaid payments for eligible care at participating communities
revenue_model.category: service fees; rental or leasing; healthcare reimbursement

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates owned and leased residential communities for older adults; service provider: Uses on-site care and hospitality staff to deliver daily living assistance, memory care, and skilled nursing to residents

geography_served.value: US national: Senior living communities across multiple regions of the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Assisted living, memory care, independent living, and continuing care retirement communities

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Community tours and on-site admissions; direct sales: Community and centralized sales teams working with prospective residents and families; online: Company website for community searches, inquiries, and tour requests

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing for assisted living and skilled nursing, plus federal certification rules for participating nursing facilities
